# Puck Dribble Trainer (퍽 드리블 트레이너)

> Puck Dribble Trainer is a free web game that uses the camera on your phone, iPad or laptop to track your puck and stick, so you can train ice hockey stickhandling at home. There is no app to install: it runs in the browser.

퍽 드리블 트레이너는 휴대폰·아이패드·노트북 카메라로 퍽과 스틱을 인식해, 집에서 아이스하키 스틱핸들링을 훈련하는 무료 웹 게임입니다. 앱 설치 없이 브라우저에서 바로 시작합니다.

## Key facts
- Price: free to play. Members (joined with an invite code) also get leaderboards and community posting.
- Devices: iPad and tablets, iPhone and Android phones, laptops with a webcam. Runs in a modern browser; can be added to the home screen.
- Privacy: the camera video is processed on the device only. It is never saved or uploaded. Visits and plays are counted with Google Analytics without personal details.
- Any object can be the puck: a puck, a ball or a bottle cap that stands out from the floor. A white pad or a plain mat works best.
- Languages: Korean (https://puck-trainer.com/) and English (https://puck-trainer.com/en/).
- Leaderboards: world, country, team and age group (U8–U18, adult, senior).

## The 7 games
- **Arcade** (아케이드): Dodge the falling red pucks side to side and collect coins. Every change of direction (a touch) scores. 1, 3 or 5 minutes. Trains: Side-to-side stickhandling · seeing the play while handling the puck · quick decisions.
- **Dodge** (퍽 피하기): Avoid red pucks flying in from all four sides. More come as time goes on. Trains: 360° puck control · stops and changes of direction · reading danger.
- **Wide Dribble** (와이드 드리블): Three drills in a row that take the puck all the way to each side. A touch counts when the puck enters a red zone drawn on your floor. Trains: Wide stickhandling · reach · rhythm.
- **Figure 8** (8자 드리블): Take the puck through the gates in a figure 8 around two cones. You pick the first cone and the direction. Trains: Forehand–backhand transitions · protecting the puck · keeping control through turns.
- **Quick Hands** (퀵 핸즈): Touch the puck side to side as fast as you can in a box at 3, 6 and 9 o’clock in turn, for the time you pick (1, 3 or 5 minutes) at each. Trains: Wrist speed · soft hands · short touches.
- **Reaction Target** (반응 타겟): Get the puck to targets that pop up anywhere, as fast as you can. Reaction time and travel time are timed separately. Trains: Reaction speed · first touch · changing direction.
- **Free Practice** (자유 연습): Build your own course with numbered points and time every lap. Share it in the community and race other players. Trains: Any drill a coach wants · timed repetitions.
